chunks: 3024 - And Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār narrated from him, saying:
"It is appropriate for one who hastens in two days to refrain from hunting until the third day has passed."

key_terms.الْيَوْمُ الثَّالِثُ: the third day, whose completion marks the end of this restriction
key_terms.يَوْمَيْنِ: the two days in which the pilgrim leaves early from Minā

ai.seo_question: Must a pilgrim who hastens departure from Minā after two days still avoid hunting until the third day ends?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling related to the pilgrim who departs early from Minā after two days. It instructs such a person to continue refraining from hunting until the end of the third day, showing that some restrictions remain in effect despite an early departure.
